subject: Re: LumenWave POC - bridge structure, eng hours & discount
messages:
From: Elena Ramos <elena@lumenwave.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: LumenWave Procurement <procurement@lumenwave.ai>
Date: 2026-06-20T09:12:00Z
Subject: LumenWave POC - runway / bridge ask

Hi Jordan,

Quick one — the team ran into higher-than-expected token spend during a classifier stress run and we’re at ~80% of the agreed timebox with three weeks left. The proof-of-concept has been going well but we need to either: (A) extend the timebox by 3 weeks, or (B) get an engineering-hours + credits top-up to finish the integration work.

Can you confirm what flexibility Redwood has for a short bridge? Specifically:
- Is there a short-term credit bucket (non-recoupable) you can provide?
- Can you add 20 engineering support hours for the remainder of the POC at a reduced rate?
- Any chance for a one-time pilot discount on token pricing while we finish validation?

Procurement asked me to get concrete numbers so they can greenlight internally — we can fast-track if legal DocuSigns a short addendum.

Thanks,
Elena
Head of ML, LumenWave

---
Attachment: LumenWave-POC-error-log.txt (text/stub)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ramos <elena@lumenwave.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-20T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: LumenWave POC - runway / bridge ask

Elena — thank you for the note and the log. Glad to hear the validation is progressing. We have three pragmatic options that should map to your internal approvals:

Option 1 — 3-week timebox extension (no billing change):
- Extend timebox by 21 days, same rate card. Requires a short SOW addendum. No extra engineering hours included.

Option 2 — Credits + low-cost eng hours (recommended):
- One-time credit of $5,000 applied to hosted usage (non-recoupable).
- 20 engineering hours at 50% of our standard SE rate, to be consumed during extension window.
- Requires a one-page addendum and PO/DocuSign.

Option 3 — Temporary pilot discount on token pricing:
- 10% off token rate for the remainder of the POC, capped at $6k savings.
- No engineering hours.

Marissa: can you confirm availability for 20 hours and whether there are any deliverables we should scope up front?
Kimberly: I can approve Option 2 on a discretionary basis pending procurement signoff; want to confirm in thread before I issue the formal quote.

If you can tell us which option you prefer by EOD Tue (6/22) we’ll send the addendum + quote and loop legal for a fast DocuSign.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0123

---
Attachment: none
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>, Elena Ramos <elena@lumenwave.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-21T08:22:00Z
Subject: Re: LumenWave POC - runway / bridge ask

Thanks Jordan — happy to support. Quick notes from an engineering POV:
- 20 SE hours is doable in the next 3 weeks; target work would be: one on-site (remote) pairing session to lock down production prompts, a KV cache tuning pass, and help on our batch/stream config to reduce token churn.
- If they pick Option 2, I’ll draft a short checklist of deliverables and milestones we’ll cover in those hours so procurement can sign off.
- If you want deeper changes (model quantization or custom kernel changes) we’d need to scope separately and that pushes cost.

Elena — coupling the credits with targeted SE time usually finishes the last mile faster than discounting token rates. Happy to jump on a 30-min call to align scope.

-M
Marissa Cole
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Elena Ramos <elena@lumenwave.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: LumenWave Procurement <procurement@lumenwave.ai>
Date: 2026-06-22T13:47:00Z
Subject: Re: LumenWave POC - runway / bridge ask

Hey team — appreciate the clear options. LumenWave prefers Option 2 (credit + discounted SE hours). A couple clarifications from procurement before we loop legal:
- Can the $5k credit be applied to the invoice immediately (we don’t want the credit tied to future commitments).
- Please confirm the exact SE hourly rate you’ll use for the discounted 20 hours and whether unused hours roll over (we don’t expect roll-over).
- We need lead time for a PO; can you produce a formal quote with line items (credit, SE hours, addendum SOW) so Procurement can route?

If you can put the quote and a 1-page addendum on DocuSign by EOD Wednesday (6/24) we’ll start internal approvals and aim to sign the same day.

Thanks,
Elena

- Addendum: timebox extended by 21 days from execution date.
